worksheet.firstUseDisclosure: Enter the changes you want to model. The worksheet estimates how they would affect your allocation using your recorded holdings, prices, and target. It does not recommend investments or place trades.
worksheet.fullDisclosure: You chose the positions, accounts, and changes shown here. Wealthfolio uses your recorded holdings, prices, exchange rates, and target to estimate their effect on your allocation. It does not choose investments, determine suitable changes, or execute transactions. Actual results may differ because prices can change and fees, taxes, and execution are not included.
worksheet.exportDisclosure: Created from adjustments entered by the user. Wealthfolio calculated estimated quantities and allocation effects using recorded data; it did not select investments or execute transactions. Verify all details before acting. This is not investment, tax, legal, or financial advice.
